key_highlights: ASX mixed: energy and big miners rally but oil-driven slide pressure and bond market rout weigh on sentiment
Iron ore weakness prompts BHP strategic review; commodity headwinds persist for materials sector
Australian housing price falls accelerate; RBA unlikely to intervene, raising GFC-comparison fears
Gold sector active with multiple discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Larvotto NSW, Kaiser Tassie) supporting miners
Bond market rout signals global financial stress; AUD stronger on oil but vulnerable to risk-off flows
Gas crisis divides Australian energy industry; construction sector under stress with Bathla suspensions
Consumer pressure intensifies: mortgage costs driving second jobs, Australians feeling poorer

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and FMG, but gold discoveries (Forrestania, Larvotto, Kaiser, Aureka) and uranium exploration (Infini, enCore) provide offset. BHP strategic review signals structural concern.
sectors.implications: Rotate from iron ore exposure to gold/uranium names. BHP.AX and FMG.AX face downside; gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX, WES.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Rally on rising oil prices and tanker-war geopolitics, but domestic gas crisis creates structural supply concerns. Tanker wars unlikely to sustain oil upside long-term.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike; gas-focused names face regulatory and supply risk. Monitor LNG contract pricing.

sectors.trend: Property GFC fears and accelerating housing falls threaten NPLs. RBA unlikely to cut rates, keeping mortgage stress elevated. Bond market rout pressures funding costs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising credit risk. Defensive positioning warranted. Monitor RBA commentary on property.

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and GFC comparisons create severe downside. RBA inaction removes policy support. Construction stress (Bathla) signals broader sector fragility.
sectors.implications: AVH.AX, CGP.AX, DGP.AX under pressure. Avoid residential REITs; commercial may be less correlated.

sectors.trend: Mortgage costs driving second jobs; consumer confidence weak. Costco global growth positive but domestic spending constrained. Cigarette tax debate adds political noise.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOL.AX, CSG.AX defensive but face volume pressure. Tobacco names (BAT, LOR.AX) face tax risk.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control; Nvidia-Broadcom silicon competition signals AI capex shifts. Cybersecurity stocks strong globally.
sectors.implications: SWM.AX governance shift; monitor for strategic changes. Global tech (NVDA, AUDC) relevant for ASX tech proxies.

key_themes: Iron ore structural decline vs gold/uranium rotation
Australian property GFC risk with RBA inaction
Global bond market rout and financial stability concerns
Geopolitical oil premium (Iran, tanker wars) vs supply resilience
Consumer squeeze from mortgage costs and cost-of-living
Domestic gas supply crisis and energy security

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce residential REIT and bank exposure; diversify into gold and energy hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond market rout / financial crisis trajectory
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain liquidity; avoid leveraged positions; monitor 10Y yields and credit spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse impacting BHP/FMG
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, FMG.AX; rotate to gold miners and uranium explorers
Hedge with energy and gold; monitor oil and AUD/USD volatility
Monitor energy policy; favour integrated majors over pure-play gas

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand collapse from mortgage stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, CSG.AX) over discretionary

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and discovery momentum
opportunities.rationale: Multiple 2Moz+ discoveries, Trump-driven gold price support, bond rout driving inflows

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long energy on oil spike and tanker-war premium
opportunities.rationale: Oil rising, AUD stronger, but cap exposure as tanker wars unlikely to sustain prices

opportunities.recommendation: Uranium exploration exposure on supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: Infini 7.5% U3O8 discovery, enCore sales, nuclear renaissance theme

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce BHP and iron ore exposure; BHP strategic review signals structural decline
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crumbling, BHP mulling major strategic shift; commodity cycle turning

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential REITs and property-linked banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating housing falls, RBA inaction, GFC comparisons, rising NPL risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive allocation amid bond rout and geopolitical risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Global financial crisis trajectory, Trump policy uncertainty, midterms approaching

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely volatile and net negative. Oil-driven energy/miner rally offset by bond rout, property fears, and iron ore weakness. AUD supported by oil but vulnerable to risk-off. RBA on hold. Expect 2-3% index volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore toward gold, uranium, and energy. Property correction may extend 6-12 months. Consumer weakness pressures discretionary. Gold and defensive staples outperform. Monitor US midterms and Trump policy for global risk appetite.

Iron ore price trajectory and BHP strategic outcome
US midterms and Trump policy direction
Global bond yield stabilisation or further rout
Housing price data (CoreLogic, SQM) next release

AUD/USD and iron ore/iron ore futures
RBA cash rate and inflation data
